focus.title: 欧盟对华电动车反补贴税终裁落地，出海车企须重构定价与供应链合规
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会近日公布对华电动汽车反补贴调查终裁，决定征收为期五年的最终反补贴税，税率因企业配合程度而异。中国车企需立即评估在欧售价调整、本地化生产及供应链溯源安排，并关注与WTO争端解决并行的法律救济路径。建议企业同步审查经销协议中的关税调整条款，避免触发违约风险。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会贸易救济公告 · 2026.11.09
focus.title_en: EU Final Anti-Subsidy Duties on Chinese EVs: Exporters Must Rethink Pricing and Supply-Chain Compliance
focus.summary_en: The European Commission has published its final anti-subsidy determination on Chinese electric vehicles, imposing definitive duties for five years at rates that vary by company. Chinese automakers should immediately reassess European pricing, localisation plans and supply-chain traceability, while tracking parallel WTO dispute-settlement options. Companies are also advised to review dealer agreements for tariff-adjustment clauses to avoid breach-of-contract exposure.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission trade defence notice · 2026.11.09

case.title: 香港仲裁裁决在内地获认可执行：跨境合同约定仲裁地及送达条款的实务启示
case.summary: 某内地企业与香港公司因货物买卖合同纠纷提交香港国际仲裁中心仲裁，胜诉方向内地中级人民法院申请认可和执行。法院依据《关于内地与香港特别行政区相互执行仲裁裁决的安排》审查后予以认可。本案提示出海企业：仲裁条款应明确仲裁地、仲裁机构及送达地址，并保留完整送达证据，以降低后续执行障碍。
case.source: 来源：最高人民法院涉港仲裁司法审查典型案例 · 2026.10
case.title_en: Hong Kong Arbitral Award Recognised and Enforced in Mainland China: Lessons on Seat and Service Clauses
case.summary_en: A mainland company and a Hong Kong counterparty referred a sales-contract dispute to HKIAC arbitration; the prevailing party then sought recognition and enforcement before a mainland intermediate people's court. The court granted recognition under the Mainland-Hong Kong Arrangement on Mutual Enforcement of Arbitral Awards. The case highlights the need for clear arbitration-seat, institution and service-address clauses, plus robust proof of service, to smooth later enforcement.
case.source_en: Source: SPC typical cases on judicial review of Hong Kong-related arbitration · 2026.10

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷“一站式”解纷平台扩容，涉外企业可在线申请调解与仲裁
policy.summary: 粤港澳大湾区近期进一步整合跨境商事调解与仲裁资源，推动“一站式”在线解纷平台覆盖更多涉外民商事案件。企业可通过平台在线提交调解申请、选择港澳调解员，并实现调解与仲裁程序衔接。建议出海企业将平台调解条款纳入跨境合同，以降低诉讼成本并提升争议解决效率。
policy.source: 来源：粤港澳大湾区法律部门联席会议机制 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Expands One-Stop Cross-Border Dispute Platform for Online Mediation and Arbitration
policy.summary_en: The Greater Bay Area has further integrated cross-border commercial mediation and arbitration resources, expanding a one-stop online dispute-resolution platform to more foreign-related civil and commercial cases. Companies can file mediation requests online, select Hong Kong or Macao mediators, and link mediation to arbitration proceedings. Exporters should consider incorporating platform mediation clauses into cross-border contracts to cut litigation costs and speed up dispute resolution.
policy.source_en: Source: GBA legal departments joint meeting mechanism · 2026.11

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企境外架构与交易文件须提前合规布局
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资安全审查规则持续扩围，涉及半导体、人工智能、量子等敏感领域的跨境投资交易面临更严申报义务。建议中企在搭建境外投资架构前开展穿透式合规筛查，在交易文件中设置监管审批先决条件、分手费及合规陈述保证条款，并动态跟踪规则更新，避免因未申报导致交易被叫停或处罚。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部投资安全办公室规则更新 · 2026.11
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanding US Outbound Investment Rules Require Early Compliance Planning for Chinese Deals
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: US outbound investment security review continues to expand, imposing stricter filing obligations on cross-border deals touching semiconductors, AI and quantum technologies. Chinese companies should conduct look-through compliance screening before structuring offshore investments, include regulatory-approval conditions precedent, break fees and compliance representations in transaction documents, and monitor rule updates to avoid deals being blocked or penalised for non-filing.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Treasury Office of Investment Security rule updates · 2026.11
